## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Adopted settings are now printed twice by the command, so fix the duplicate adoption output before merge.

## Changes
`plan` now adds an `adopt` entry for each setting that already exists, and adds one `audit` entry at the end of every plan. Two tests cover the audit entry when `run` adds a setting and when the input is empty.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Stop the command printing each adoption twice — `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` now emits `["Adopted theme", "Adopted theme"]`. `plan` already emits the progress message at `app/planner.py:8`, and `app/cli.py:6-9` emits again for every non-audit change, which now includes the new `adopt` entry. No test calls `run` with an existing setting: `test_adoption_progress` calls only `plan`. — Every adopted setting appears twice in command output, which contradicts the PR body's claim that progress output is retained unchanged. — Fix: Skip `adopt` entries in `app/cli.py:7` the way `audit` entries are skipped, or drop the `emit` call in `plan`; then add a `run` test with an existing setting.
